Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Great question! Once your order ships, delivery depends on your country and shipping method:
Germany: 4–6 business days with standard DHL, or 2–3 with express DHL when ordered by 10:00 AM on a business day
Austria: 3–5 business days
Netherlands/Belgium: 3–5 with standard DHL, or 2–3 with express Budbee
France, Rest of EU, and UK: 4–7 business days
Poland: 3–5 business days
Switzerland: 3–6 business days
Track it via the dispatch email or DHL/UPS tracking number. No dispatch email yet? It hasn’t shipped; shipping can take up to 3 business days after ordering.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
ntries. In Germany, DHL express costs €6.99 and arrives in 2–3 business days when ordered by 10:00 AM on a business day. The Netherlands and Belgium also offer Budbee express delivery in 2–3 business days. France, Austria, Poland, and some other destinations currently list only standard delivery. If express is available for your country, select it at checkout; otherwise, the fastest option depends on your delivery country. I hope this helps!
